hole: grown-up pokes with a pencil/awl
Calibration: the black bar must measure
exactly 100 mm and the square 20x20 mm.
Use card ~1 mm (cereal box) for parts.
github.com/dev-repos/kids-robotics-projects · Kids.JoinDev · CC BY 4.0 · Grown-ups do all craft-knife cutting.
Build one step at a time. Colour = the new part, grey = already done. ! = grown-up step.
Skewer 22 mm x2, straw 5 mm + 8 mm
Glue a peg in each hip hole, 26 mm above
Peg sticks out straight, not tilted.
Slide the leg (sleeve in hip hole) on
the left peg; glue a button on the
Leg swings freely, button stops it
Skewer 18 mm, straw roller 6 mm, button
Glue the crank pin, slip the roller on,
put it in the slot, button outside.
Roller slides along the slot without
